playbook:
PLAYBOOK -- design X-demo7 (carried under E-9004, registration REG-demo)
The declaration: prereg/X-demo7_playbook.json, sha256 8730beb562c6aff78198f94e5bce00676ea003e1171421bbd404e50973b9cfc2 (pinned in E-9004).

HAND ENTRY ONLY. You enter every order yourself, by hand, on the firm's platform. Nothing in this playbook or its alerts places, sends or automates an order: no automated or API order entry, ever (it gets prop accounts banned).
NEVER HOLD OPPOSITE POSITIONS AT ONCE across your accounts or firms. While any position is open in any of your accounts, a new trade is taken only on that position's side; otherwise skip it.
One trade goes to one account. Never copy a trade to several accounts.
Never put size into major news: no entry and no working order inside a news window; a position open when a window starts is closed at its start.
No price is printed here: every order is stated against what you read on your platform when the alert reaches you. Bars are named by their stamp, the minute they open, as platforms label them.

FIRM AND PLAN
Firm: topstep; plan: 50K Trading Combine (as the firm's verified rules name it); instrument: MNQ.
Accounts, in the account order:
  - ts_a1: an evaluation account (the Trading Combine); at most 50 contracts of MNQ open at once (the firm's verified limit).
  - ts_b2: a funded account (the Express Funded Account; its scaling plan's entry tier, the lowest, bounds the size); at most 20 contracts of MNQ open at once (the firm's verified limit).
  - ts_c3: an evaluation account (the Trading Combine); at most 50 contracts of MNQ open at once (the firm's verified limit).

COMPONENTS (one session window each; times in CT, Chicago)
Component ldn_brk -- session london: orders go live on the bars stamped 03:00 CT to 04:00 CT.
  Trigger (p14): a breakout: the first one-minute close above the previous completed reference bar's high, or below its low (the reference bar's length in minutes is the parameter k), at most once per reference bar.
    entry: market
    first: 02:55 CT
    last: 03:55 CT
    latency: 5
  Entry: a market order when the order goes live. The alert reaches you 5 minutes before the order goes live.
  Side (the trigger's own, cleared by the no-harm floor under E-9001):
    with the breakout: BUY after a close above the reference bar's high, SELL after a close below its low.
    On the search years (the years this design was chosen on): the trigger side's composite 0.31, the coin side's 0.3, the margin 0.05.
  Size: 3 contracts of MNQ.
  Stop: 77 ticks from your fill. Target: 100 ticks (reward to risk 1.3). Both are placed with the entry as a bracket.
  The session's local open: 08:00 Europe/London.
    on 2021-03-16 that is 03:00 CT
    on 2021-04-06 that is 02:00 CT
Component am_rl3 -- session ny_am: orders go live on the bars stamped 09:00 CT to 09:55 CT.
  Trigger (rl3): pre-session tickets at the day's levels of one kind, fixed when the alert is sent, before the regular session's first fill; the tickets of a kind are one order, one-cancels-other, unfilled tickets cancelled at the cutoff.
    cutoff: 10:00 CT
    kind: pd
  Entry: each level's ticket by its declared rule (a fade is a limit at the level, a break a stop one tick beyond it), all the kind's tickets placed together in one account as one one-cancels-other order. The tickets are fixed at 08:30 CT, when the alert is sent, and go live on the bar stamped 09:00 CT.
  Side (the trigger's own, cleared by the no-harm floor under E-9001):
    at the previous day's regular-session high: fade: a limit at the level against the approach (SELL at a level above the price at the alert, BUY at one below it).
    at the previous day's regular-session low: break: a stop one tick beyond the level (BUY above a level above the price at the alert, SELL below one below it).
    On the search years (the years this design was chosen on): the trigger side's composite 0.27, the coin side's 0.29, the margin 0.05.
  Size: 2 contracts of MNQ on each ticket.
  Stop: 100 ticks from your fill. Target: 150 ticks (reward to risk 1.5). Both are placed with the entry as a bracket.
  The session's local open: 09:30 America/New_York.
    on 2021-03-16 that is 08:30 CT
    on 2021-04-06 that is 08:30 CT
Component pm_brk -- session ny_pm: orders go live on the bars stamped 11:00 CT to 14:00 CT.
  Trigger (p14): a breakout: the first one-minute close above the previous completed reference bar's high, or below its low (the reference bar's length in minutes is the parameter k), at most once per reference bar.
    entry: limit
    first: 10:57 CT
    last: 13:57 CT
    latency: 3
  Entry: a limit order at the price at the alert (the close of the last bar closed when the alert is sent), working the limit window from when it goes live, cancelled if unfilled. The alert reaches you 3 minutes before the order goes live.
  Side (the trigger's own, cleared by the no-harm floor under E-9001):
    against the breakout: SELL after a close above the reference bar's high, BUY after a close below its low.
    On the search years (the years this design was chosen on): the trigger side's composite 0.4, the coin side's 0.33, the margin 0.05.
  Size: 1 contracts of MNQ.
  Stop: 60 ticks from your fill. Target: 135 ticks (reward to risk 2.25). Both are placed with the entry as a bracket.
  The session's local open: 09:30 America/New_York.
    on 2021-03-16 that is 08:30 CT
    on 2021-04-06 that is 08:30 CT
The no-harm floor's file: results/noharm_x.csv (commit abc1234def): the trigger's own side against the coin's on the real path, same fills, no redraw; the margin 0.05 is set under E-9002; each component's side passed: its composite not below the coin's by more than the margin.

EXECUTION RULES (every component)
- One position or working entry order at a time per firm (one level kind's tickets count as one order); after a position closes, wait at least 5 minutes before the next entry.
- Limit orders work 30 minutes from going live, then are cancelled.
- Closed window: no entry and no fill on the bars stamped 08:30 CT through 08:59 CT, every day.
- On a jobs-report day: no fill on the bars stamped up to 07:35 CT.
- No new entry after 15:08 CT. Flatten every position by the close of the bar stamped 15:07 CT (it ends at 15:08 CT) at the latest.
- A working order is cancelled when a news or closed window starts; an open position is closed at its start.
News windows (no entry and no fill inside them), from the synthetic release record:
  - CPI (synthetic record key): released at 07:30 CT; the window covers the bars stamped from 2 minutes before the release to 7 minutes after it; on 2021-03-16, 2021-04-07.
  - a synthetic afternoon release: released at 12:00 CT; the window covers the bars stamped from 3 minutes before the release to 6 minutes after it; on 2021-03-17.
Void days (no trade from the components named; all known before the alert):
  - an FOMC statement day: no trade at all that day.
  - an exchange holiday or a scheduled early close before the day's flatten: no trade that day.
  - the day after a scheduled early close, a closure (a weekday without a session) or a contract roll: no trade from a component that reads the previous day's levels.
  - 2021-03-19: an exchange holiday or a scheduled early close before the day's flatten: no trade that day.

ACCOUNT ROTATION
Rule by_component: each component's trades go to its own pool of accounts below, the one waiting longest first (a component without a pool uses every account). Each alert names the account the rule picks.
  component am_rl3: ts_a1, ts_c3
  component pm_brk: ts_b2
One trade goes to one account. Never copy a trade to several accounts.

THE BANKROLL STOP
Budget: $1700 (set under E-9002). When your total spending on this plan reaches it before a first payout, stop: buy no further evaluation and no reset, add no money, and keep trading only the accounts you already hold until each is passed or lost.

THE EXPECTED JOURNEY
From the result file results/journey_x.csv (commit abc1234def), measured on this declaration:
  - sessions to the first payout: 37.5 (search years: the years this design was chosen on, so likely better than what follows; median)
    its held-out reading is not named here: read it beside before trusting this figure.
  - chance of running out at the budget: 0.1234 (search years: the years this design was chosen on, so likely better than what follows; value)
    its held-out reading is not named here: read it beside before trusting this figure.
  - bankroll needed, unlucky tenth: 1543.25 (search years: the years this design was chosen on, so likely better than what follows; p90)
  - bankroll needed, unlucky tenth: 1611.5 (held-out years, reported beside, never judged; p90)
These figures were measured with every trade's direction replaced by a fair coin (zero edge), over many start days: they are what the account policy gives without any skill in direction. Your own journey will differ.
The backtests behind these figures also left out, for data reasons you cannot see and need not judge (research filters, not trading rules):
  - days whose stored bars end before the walk's last bar, end early or carry a data defect, and the day after one.
  - overnight sessions with too many stored minutes missing.
